name: Lazertinib
mechanism: Irreversible, mutant-selective, CNS-penetrant EGFR TKI that covalently binds C797. Used in combination with amivantamab for first-line EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
monitoring: Prophylactic anticoagulation and dermatological care when combined with amivantamab
resistance: Expected to share third-generation mechanisms (C797S, MET amplification, histological transformation); combination with amivantamab may reduce bypass-driven resistance.
